method: Construct Sp6(2), its point stabilizer 2^5:S6, and the unique A5 class whose 2^5 module has orbit/span profile (1,1),(1,2),(15,32)x2. Transport each exact marked Q1920 tuple into this subgroup and exhaust Aut(Q) modulo automorphisms induced by the Sp6 normalizer.
scope: This exhausts every embedding of either marked Q1920 onto the canonical outer-A5 parabolic slice, modulo ambient conjugacy. It does not exclude other finite groups generated by moved conjugates of V.
